goals: Enable one-click deployment of the blog to Vercel from the GitHub repository
Allow environment variables (e.g. Gist ID) to be configured in the Vercel dashboard
Trigger automatic deployments on every push to the main branch
Ensure the project builds and deploys without errors

userStories.title: Connect repository to Vercel
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to connect the GitHub repository to a Vercel project so that the blog can be deployed from the cloud.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Developer can import the repo via Vercel dashboard or CLI
First deployment runs successfully (build completes without errors)
Deployment produces a live URL (production or preview)

userStories.title: Configure environment variables
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to set environment variables (e.g. Gist ID) in the Vercel dashboard so that the deployed site fetches the correct content.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Environment variables configured in Vercel are available at build and runtime
Deployed site displays posts correctly when Gist ID is set
Visually verified in browser at the deployment URL

userStories.title: Automatic deployment on push
userStories.description: As a developer, I want each push to the main branch to trigger a new deployment so that changes go live without manual steps.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Push to main triggers a new Vercel deployment
Build completes successfully and deployment is live

functionalRequirements.description: The Next.js project must be compatible with Vercel’s build and runtime (no blocking config).
All required environment variables must be documented for Vercel setup.
Build output must succeed with `next build` in a Vercel-like environment.
